Sets all bits with indexes that are in range [from:to].

detaileddescription.para: > Note: the range is inclusive both bits at index from and index to will be set.

bitmap
address of vbitmap_t object.
from
index of the LSB in the range.
to
index of the MSB in the range.
> Note: This function is not atomic. Bits inside the range might not be raised at once. Raising bits occur in multiple steps.
